MADE FOR FRIENDLY RIVALRIES.Keyboard + gamepad support / No controllers connected
A CRASH COURSE

Be the last one standing.

Move around the platform and dash into opponents to knock them into the void. Your damage increases when you get hit, making you easier to launch. The arena starts shrinking after 18 seconds.

Player 1W A S D · Space to dash

Player 2Arrow keys · Enter to dash

Player 3I J K L · U to dash

Player 4T F G H · R to dash

GamepadLeft stick / D-pad · A / ✕ to dash

TouchLeft thumbstick · DASH button

Select a keyboard, bot, or connected controller for each player in the lobby. Controllers must use a standard browser mapping. Some keyboards limit simultaneous key presses; gamepads work well for four people.

Press Esc to pause. A ring around your fighter shows your dash recharge. The first player to reach the selected number of round wins takes the match.
